第1章(1)

景国，金陵。

日头初升，和煦的阳光洒落在这座刚刚苏醒的京城重地，青石板铺就的宽阔街道上，一辆锦缎豪华马车正急速行驶。

马车内燃着玉华香，铺着虎皮毯子，百鸟朝凤锦缎上正半躺半坐着一位似睡非醒的俊美青年，他身着紫色锦缎长衣，外面罩着件银缎面雪白貂毛做里的连帽斗篷，斗篷的系扣乃是一枚鸽子蛋大小的紫色宝石，流光溢彩，华贵无匹。

可是这一切，都比不过青年本身的容颜如玉，俊美逼人。他的肌肤光滑白皙，宛如上好的羊脂白玉，双眉清晰挺秀，双目清湛幽深，鼻梁高挺，嘴唇秀气，就连他微微抬高的下巴似乎都比别人更迷人一些。

此时这位俊美贵公子正迷迷糊糊地半睁半闭着眼睛，心不在焉地敲着修长白皙的手指。

书童银子焦虑又担心地看着自家公子原平之，不时扭头再看看马车外的侍卫邵五和随从金子，而围绕在马车四周的御林军才是银子焦虑的最大原因。

今天一大早公子就被御林军从金陵最大的烟花之地迷楼里架出来，抬上了马车就一路疾行，而所行的方向显然并非原府，亦非常去的皇宫，那么是要去哪里？前途可有凶险？

看公子好像还未从昨夜的宿醉与美梦中清醒，一副天塌下来也无所谓的样子，银子就不由得焦急，并感叹：他家公子被誉为「金陵第一纨裤」，可真是名副其实。

「公子，您醒醒啊，难道您就不担心吗？」银子摇着自家公子的手臂，说：「您可是被绑架了啊！」

一直陪伴在马车旁边的随从金子笑出声来，说：「银子，你可真逗。放眼金陵城，不，就是放眼全国，谁敢绑架咱家公子？」

侍卫邵五插嘴道：「有人敢的。」

金子骑在马上，用手摸了摸自己硬硬的胡碴，说：「当然了，天下皇上最大。可是除了皇上之外，还有人敢吗？」

邵五不吭声了。

对于金陵第一纨裤原平之原四公子来说，皇上第一他第二，天下间再没有人敢惹他，就因为皇上在他后头撑腰，连他的老爹和长兄都管不太动他。

刚刚十五岁的银子皱了皱眉头，他才跟了公子一年，对于提拔他的原四公子很是感恩，所以自然处处小心伺候，唯恐哪里不周到，但他还未意识到自家公子是个怎样的金贵主儿。

别的不说，原平之身边的侍卫邵五就不是原家的普通侍卫，而是皇帝将自己身边的暗卫特别钦赐给原平之的。

只不过，邵五到了原平之身边，由暗卫变成了明卫，原平之不喜欢偷偷摸摸暗中保护那一套。

皇帝玄昱手下到底有多少暗卫外臣不清楚，但是十大暗卫是最出名的，这十大暗卫身手之高外人难以想象，按照姓氏和数位排列，邵五排名第五，其能力不言而喻。

要知道，一些不受宠的皇子和皇女身边，都是没有暗卫保护的。原平之身为外臣之子却能得到邵五一直以来的随身保护，难怪外界纷纷传言皇帝玄昱与原平之之间有着某种不可言说的暧昧关系。

原平之是皇帝的嫡亲姨表兄弟，自幼关系亲密，在原家的四个姨表兄弟中，玄昱最疼爱宠信的就是原四公子，不仅因为原四比他小，更因为原四长得最俊美漂亮。

没办法，景国的皇帝就是个不可救药的好色鬼。

对于漂亮可爱、赏心悦目的人儿，无论男女，皇帝大人都拥有无限的耐心与容忍度，这种人性里天生的缺点，让朝中那些有才无貌的大佬就算不甘心，也只能徒呼奈何。

在原平之懒洋洋的无所谓中，在银子的担心忧虑中，马车最终驶进了一座华美幽静的大宅。

马车在二门外停下，原平之伸了伸懒腰，悠哉地喝了杯茶，才缓缓从马车里走下来，迎接他的是两个上了年纪的嬷嬷。

大宅门的规矩，二门内不随便放外来男子进入的，男仆更是绝对不允许踏入，就连侍卫邵五也被隔绝在了二门以外。

银子担心地看着公子的身影远去，皱着清秀的小脸道：「这是哪里啊？公子会不会有事啊？」

随从金子已经跟随了原平之六年，交际应酬多是他跑腿，对于金陵城里的达官贵人已经摸熟了，于是说道：「别担心，这里是升平大长公主府，是皇帝姑母家，谁敢对公子不敬啊？」

邵五用他一贯严肃的表情道：「难说，也许大长公主就会为难公子。」

金子白了他一眼，说：「那也要看皇帝乐不乐意。」

在金子的心里，他家公子就算要星星，皇帝大人也会努力去摘取，所以铁定不会为难他家公子的。

只是，这次金子似乎料错了。

原平之跟随着两位嬷嬷穿越廊庭，一路走到内宅，走进大长公主所居住的庭院。

在堂屋门外，一位嬷嬷恭谨地对原平之道：「冒昧请原公子前来，老奴代公主向公子谢罪。如非万不得已，公主也不会出此下策，还望公子一会儿见了公主能够担待一二。」

另一位嬷嬷道：「公主病重已久，如今自知大限将至，再也撑不下去，才向皇帝陛下请了旨意，得到陛下的允许，特意请公子过来的。」

原平之扬了扬眉，他虽然向来随心所欲惯了，也随遇而安惯了，并不太在乎大长公主强行将他请来，但是玄昱居然也从中插了一脚？

这事倒有点蹊跷了。

原平之不认为自己有什么值得别人巴结的，尤其是对于一国公主而言。

他虽然自认文韬武略皆有涉猎，但是他并不热中于做官，所以到现在还是闲散人士一枚，说好听点是闲云野鹤，难听点就是米虫。

不过，皇帝确实很偏心，原平之不爱做官，皇帝就特意封了他一个宗室子弟才能享有的爵位——镇国将军，这个爵位仅次于亲王爵和郡王爵，显贵不言而喻。

因为这个封爵，朝廷里还好生吵闹了一阵，皆因为景国的爵位制度分为宗室爵和异姓爵，宗室爵自然都是皇帝那一家子的，而异姓爵则是封给那些异姓功臣的。

原平之不做官，于国家而言无功，不可封异姓爵；可他又不姓玄，并非皇帝的本家亲属，自然也不能封宗室爵。可是皇帝一意孤行，给了原平之镇国将军的爵位，在朝廷大臣们的眼里，这既是败坏朝廷律法，又是败坏祖宗家法，根本就是色迷心窍，要知幸臣、佞臣乃坏国之根本啊！

大臣们在朝堂上吵了好一阵子，御史台更是上了各种弹劾折子，但原平之不做官，装不知道；玄昱做皇帝，把各种弹劾统统压下，装没事。

这样吵闹了几个月，大臣们也无奈了，反过来想想，皇帝虽然偶尔好色无度，但在国家大事上还算勤政英明；原平之虽然无功封爵，但他也算皇亲国戚，是和皇帝有血缘关系的姨表兄弟，而且他也不插手国事，只是游手好闲，于国于民无害，这样说来，也就算了吧。大臣们的职责之一就是包容皇帝偶尔的任性，这也实在是因为没办法。

经过镇国将军爵位被弹劾一事，原平之的名声越发显赫，更加坐实了「金陵第一纨裤」的名号，但是平常围绕在他身边的多是官宦豪门子弟，大家一起寻芳问柳，喝酒玩乐，鲜少有正经人士找原平之，对于真正的朝廷菁英来说，他们根本就不把这个纨裤米虫看在眼里。

Chapter 1(1)

Jingguo, Jinling.

The sun was rising, and the warm sunshine was shining on the newly awakened capital city. On the wide street paved with bluestones, a brocade luxury carriage was driving rapidly.

The carriage was burning with the incense of jade flowers, and was covered with a tiger skin blanket. A handsome young man, half asleep and half awake, was sitting on the bird-facing phoenix brocade. He was wearing a long purple brocade coat, and a hooded cloak made of silver satin and snow-white mink fur. The buckle of the cloak was a purple gem the size of a pigeon egg, which was full of brilliance and luxury.

But all of this is incomparable to the young man's own face, which is as handsome as jade.His skin is smooth and white, like the finest mutton-fat white jade, his eyebrows are clear and straight, his eyes are clear and deep, his nose is high and his lips are delicate. Even his slightly raised chin seems more charming than others.

At this time, this handsome and noble young man was half-opening and half-closing his eyes in a daze, tapping his long white fingers absentmindedly.

The bookboy Yinzi looked at his young master Yuan Pingzhi anxiously and worriedly. From time to time he turned to look at the guard Shao Wu and his attendant Jinzi outside the carriage. The imperial guards surrounding the carriage were the biggest cause of Yinzi's anxiety.

Early this morning, the Young Master was carried out by the Royal Guards from the Mysterious Tower, the largest fireworks place in Jinling. He was carried on the carriage and drove all the way. The direction he was traveling in was obviously not the original palace, which was also the palace he was not visiting, so where were he going?Is the future dangerous?

Seeing that the young master seems to have not yet woken up from last night's hangover and dream, and looks like it doesn't matter if the sky falls, Yinzi can't help but feel anxious, and sighs: His young master is known as the "No. 1 dandy in Jinling", and he really lives up to his reputation.

"Master, wake up, aren't you worried?" Yinzi shook his master's arm and said, "You have been kidnapped!"

Jin Zi, the attendant who had been accompanying the carriage, laughed out loud and said, "Yin Zi, you are so funny. Looking at Jinling City, no, looking at the whole country, who dares to kidnap our young master?"

Guard Shao Wu interrupted: "Someone dares."

Jin Zi rode on the horse, touched his hard beard with his hand, and said, "Of course, the emperor is the greatest in the world. But besides the emperor, does anyone else dare?"

Shao Wu remained silent.

For the Fourth Young Master Yuan Pingzhiyuan, the No. 1 dandy in Jinling, the emperor is first and he is second. No one in the world dares to mess with him. Just because the emperor is behind him, not even his father and eldest brother can care about him.

Yinzi, who had just turned fifteen years old, frowned. He had only been with the young master for a year. He was very grateful to the former fourth young master who promoted him, so naturally he served him carefully, fearing that he was not considerate, but he had not yet realized what kind of noble master his young master was.

Apart from anything else, Shao Wu, the guard beside Yuan Pingzhi, was not an ordinary guard of the Yuan family, but a secret guard specially given to Yuan Pingzhi by the emperor.

However, when Shao Wu arrived at Yuan Pingzhi's side, he changed from a secret guard to an open guard. Yuan Pingzhi didn't like the idea of ​​protecting him secretly.

It is unclear how many secret guards there are under Emperor Xuan Yu, but the top ten secret guards are the most famous. The skills of these top ten secret guards are unimaginable to outsiders. Arranged by surname and number, Shao Wu ranks fifth, and his ability is self-evident.

You know, some unfavored princes and princesses are not protected by secret guards.As the son of a foreign minister, Yuan Pingzhi has always been protected by Shao Wu. No wonder the outside world has spread rumors that there is some unspeakable ambiguous relationship between Emperor Xuan Yu and Yuan Pingzhi.

Yuan Pingzhi is the emperor's direct aunt and cousin, and they have been close since childhood. Among the four aunts and cousins ​​in the Yuan family, the fourth son of Yuan is the one that Xuan Yu loves and favors the most, not only because Yuan Si is younger than him, but also because Yuan Si is the most handsome.

There is no way, the emperor of Jingguo is an incorrigible lecher.

The emperor has infinite patience and tolerance for beautiful, lovely and pleasing people, regardless of gender. This inherent shortcoming of human nature makes the talented and handsome bosses in the court do nothing even if they are unwilling to give up.

Amidst Yuan Ping's lazy indifference and Yin Zi's worries, the carriage finally drove into a gorgeous and quiet mansion.

The carriage stopped outside the second door. Yuan Pingzhi stretched and drank a cup of tea leisurely before slowly getting out of the carriage. He was greeted by two elderly nuns.

According to the rules of the mansion gate, outside men are not allowed to enter the second gate, and male servants are absolutely not allowed to enter. Even the guard Shao Wu is isolated from the second gate.

Yinzi watched the young master's figure go away worriedly, wrinkled his delicate face and said, "Where are you? Will the young master be okay?"

The follower Jin Zi has been with Yuan Ping for six years. He mostly runs errands for social events and is already familiar with the dignitaries in Jinling City, so he said: "Don't worry, this is the mansion of Princess Shengping and the emperor's aunt's house. Who dares to be disrespectful to the young master?"

Shao Wu said with his usual serious expression: "It's hard to say, maybe the eldest princess will embarrass the young master."

Jin Zi rolled his eyes at him and said, "It depends on whether the emperor is happy or not."

In Jin Zi's heart, even if his young master wants a star, the emperor will work hard to pick it up, so he will definitely not embarrass his young master.

However, this time the gold seemed to be wrong.

Yuan Pingzhi followed the two nuns through the corridor, walked all the way to the inner house, and entered the courtyard where the eldest princess lived.

Outside the main hall door, a nun said to Yuan Ping respectfully: "I take the liberty to invite Mr. Yuan to come. I will apologize to you on behalf of the princess. The princess will not take this step unless it is absolutely necessary. I hope that the master can bear with her when she sees her soon."

Another nun said: "The princess has been seriously ill for a long time. Now she knows that her end is approaching and she can no longer survive, so she asked for a decree from His Majesty the Emperor. With His Majesty's permission, she specially invited the young master to come here."

Yuan Pingzhi raised his eyebrows. Although he was used to doing whatever he wanted and adapting to the situation, he didn't care much about the eldest princess forcing him to come, but Xuan Yu actually had a hand in it?

This is a bit strange.

Yuan Pingzhi doesn't think he has anything worthy of being fawned over by others, especially for a princess of a country.

Although he considers himself to be involved in both literature, Taoism and military strategy, he is not keen on being an official, so he is still an idler. At best, he is an idle cloud and a crane, and at worst, he is a rice insect.

However, the emperor was indeed very partial. Yuan Pingzhi did not like to be an official, so the emperor specially gave him a title that could only be enjoyed by a descendant of the clan - general of the state. This title was second only to the prince and the county prince. It was self-evident that he was noble.

Because of this title, there was a quarrel in the court for a while, all because the title system of Jingguo was divided into clan titles and different surnames. The clan titles naturally belonged to the emperor's family, while the different surnames were awarded to those heroes with different surnames.

If Yuan Pingzhi does not serve as an official, he has no merit in the country and cannot be granted a title of a different surname. However, since he does not have the surname Xuan, he is not a relative of the emperor, so naturally he cannot be granted a title of a clan title.However, the emperor insisted on going his own way and gave Yuan Ping the title of general of the country. In the eyes of the court ministers, this was not only a corruption of the court law, but also a corruption of the ancestral family law. It was simply a matter of lust. You must know that lucky ministers and sycophants are the root of the ruin of the country!

The ministers quarreled in the court for a long time, and various impeachment accusations were made on the imperial censor's platform. However, Yuan Pingzhi pretended not to know because he was not an official;

After months of quarreling like this, the ministers were helpless. On the other hand, thinking about it, although the emperor was occasionally lecherous, he was still diligent and wise in matters of state affairs. Although Yuan Pingzhi was granted no title for no merit, he was still considered a relative of the emperor and a blood-related cousin of the emperor. Moreover, he did not interfere in state affairs, but was just idle and harmless to the country and the people. In this way, let it be forgotten.One of the responsibilities of ministers is to tolerate the emperor's occasional willfulness, but this is really because they have no choice.

After the impeachment of the title of General Zhenguo, Yuan Pingzhi's reputation became more and more prominent, and he became more and more solid as the "No. 1 dandy in Jinling". However, most of the people around him were officials and wealthy children. They all went to look for friends, drink and have fun, and few serious people came to Yuan Pingzhi. For the real court elites, they simply did not take this dandy in their eyes.
